metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows exercises that can help relieve arthritic pains around the hips and lower back.

These exercises are designed to help improve pain-free range of motion caused by osteoarthritis (aka wear-and tear arthritis). They require no equipment and can be done at home.

Watch now and get quick and long-lasting hip and back arthritis pain relief!

0:41 Morning Relief Exercise
